text: Program Description Program Overview This is a non-degree Chinese language program open to international students worldwide who are passionate about the Chinese language and wish to gain a deeper understanding of Chinese culture and the development of Chinese-style modernization. Students are placed in classes based on their proficiency levels, enabling them to systematically improve their listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills in a short period of time. Through extracurricular activities such as cultural immersion experiences and visits to companies in the Greater Bay Area, students will also have the opportunity to experience the unique charm of Chinese culture.
